aboutText: Family-owned since 1994, Mario's brings the rich culinary traditions of Rome and Naples to your table. We source organic, local ingredients and imported Italian flour to create our signature slow-rise pizza dough and handmade pasta daily.

items.name: Bruschetta Classica
items.desc: Toasted Italian bread rubbed with garlic, topped with diced vine-ripened tomatoes, fresh basil, and extra virgin olive oil.

items.name: Calamari Fritti
items.desc: Crispy, golden-fried baby squid served with fresh lemon wedges and our house spicy marinara dipping sauce.

items.name: Garlic Bread with Cheese
items.desc: Baked crusty Italian bread brushed with garlic butter, fresh parsley, and melted whole-milk mozzarella.

items.name: Lasagna Al Forno
items.desc: Baked layers of fresh pasta sheet, slow-simmered beef bolognese sauce, creamy bechamel, and melted parmigiano-reggiano.

items.name: Fettuccine Alfredo with Chicken
items.desc: Hand-cut egg fettuccine tossed in a rich, velvety butter and parmesan cream sauce, topped with grilled chicken breast.

items.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
items.desc: Classic Roman style spaghetti tossed with crispy guanciale, pasteurized egg yolks, cracked black pepper, and pecorino romano.

items.name: Pizza Margherita
items.desc: San Marzano tomato base, fresh buffalo mozzarella, fresh basil leaves, and a drizzle of organic olive oil on slow-rise crust.

items.name: Pizza Diavola
items.desc: Tomato sauce, spicy Italian salami, nduja, hot chili oil, mozzarella, and black olives.

items.name: Tiramisu della Casa
items.desc: Espresso-soaked ladyfinger cookies layered with rich whipped mascarpone cream and dusted with fine cocoa powder.

items.name: Sicilian Cannoli
items.desc: Crispy pastry tube shell filled with sweet sheep's milk ricotta cheese, chocolate chips, and candied orange peel.

reviews.author: David K.
reviews.text: The wood-fired Margherita pizza is exactly like the ones I had in Naples. Mario's is an absolute gem, outstanding service!

reviews.author: Sophia R.
reviews.text: Handmade pasta is out of this world. The lasagna is rich, layered, and baked to perfection. 5 stars all the way.

reviews.author: Mark M.
reviews.text: Incredible cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, and mouthwatering tiramisu. Tastes like home-cooked Italian comfort food.
